brief_narrative:
Atlas Logistics wants to design and pilot a digital freight-matching platform for small shippers in Iberia.

The work runs six months, including a pilot with real customers. The stakeholders are the CEO, CTO and Head of Sales. Success means 200 shippers active on the pilot.

questions.text: Is this an assessment only, or do we also support implementation?
Did Atlas Logistics ask for a specific deliverable format, such as a deck or a report?
Did Atlas Logistics set a start date or any deadlines for the six-month engagement and the pilot?
Has Atlas Logistics already tried anything toward a freight-matching platform for small shippers in Iberia?
Did Atlas Logistics exclude anything from the platform design and pilot?
